game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Mushroom Cavern Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Cavern, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the dwarf scout ahead. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the supply cache by solving code steps involving dungeon_clear that move the dwarf scout forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the supply cache first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Mushroom Cavern.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
